TRAINING REPAYMENT AGREEMENT

This Training Repayment Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of March 16, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Northwind Logistics Inc., an Ohio corporation ("Employer"), and Dana Whitfield ("Employee").

1. The Training. Employer will pay Buckeye Driver Academy, an independent training school, the tuition for Employee's commercial driver license course (the "Training"), which Employee has asked to attend. The cost of the Training to Employer is $6,500, as shown on the school's invoice attached as Exhibit A. Employer will pay Employee's regular wages for the hours spent in the Training; those wages are not part of the amount below and are never repayable.

2. Commitment Period. The "Commitment Period" is the 24 months that begin on the day Employee completes the Training.

3. When Repayment Is Owed. Employee will repay Employer the amount in Section 4 only if Employee voluntarily resigns during the Commitment Period, or if Employer ends Employee's employment during the Commitment Period for Employee's misconduct.

4. Amount. The repayment amount is $6,500, which is Employer's actual out-of-pocket cost of the Training and will in no event exceed it. The amount is prorated: it is reduced by one twenty-fourth for each full month Employee works during the Commitment Period, so that nothing is owed once the Commitment Period ends. Exhibit B shows the amount for each month.

5. When Nothing Is Owed. Nothing is owed, and Employee will not be required to repay any amount, if Employer terminates Employee's employment for any reason other than misconduct, including a layoff or the elimination of Employee's position, or if Employee's employment ends because of Employee's death or disability.

6. How Repayment Is Made. Employee may repay any amount owed in twelve equal monthly installments beginning 30 days after the last day of employment, without interest. The amount is not accelerated because the employment has ended, and Employer will not charge a fee for paying over time.

7. Deductions from Pay. Employer will not deduct any amount owed under this Agreement from Employee's wages unless Employee signs a separate written authorization at the time of the deduction, and no deduction will reduce Employee's pay below the minimum wage or exceed the amount the law of the place of work allows.

8. At-Will Employment. Nothing in this Agreement changes the at-will nature of Employee's employment or promises employment for any period.

9. General. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio, and the state courts located in Franklin County, Ohio have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising under it. This Agreement is the entire agreement of the parties about repayment of the Training and may be amended only in a writing signed by both parties. Employee has had the opportunity to review this Agreement with an advisor of Employee's choice before signing.

NORTHWIND LOGISTICS INC.

By: ______________________
Name: Harriet Cole

Dana Whitfield

EXHIBIT A

Invoice

Invoice 20418 from the training school named in Section 1, dated March 9, 2026: commercial driver license course, 160 hours. Tuition: $6,500.

EXHIBIT B

Repayment Amount by Month

Months worked in the Commitment Period, and the amount then owed: 0 months, $6,500.00; 6 months, $4,875.00; 12 months, $3,250.00; 18 months, $1,625.00; 24 months, nothing.
